[[Stormcloud Incubus|Stormcloud Incubi]] are mostly found in [[dungeon]]s. Often [[popup|dropping down]] from above to ambush players; these [[Air Magic|air]] [[elementalist]]s can do a lot of damage, as they most usually drop in large numbers. Therefore watch out for them in [[Hard mode]].
